response.sql: WITH trader_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), avg_count_cte AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) as avg_count FROM trader_counts), above_average_types AS (SELECT tc.tradekind, tc.record_count, tc.record_count * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(record_count) FROM trader_counts) as share FROM trader_counts tc WHERE tc.record_count > (SELECT avg_count FROM avg_count_cte)) SELECT SUM(record_count) as combined_number, AVG(share) as average_share, AVG(record_count) - (SELECT avg_count FROM avg_count_cte) as average_above_average FROM above_average_types
